members.name: SortAndTransportFR
members.text: The system must be capable of sorting, transporting, and storing pieces P1 and P2 in the production environment.

members.name: ConfigureMissionFR
members.text: The system must be configured at the beginning of the mission with a parameter p to assign the sorting logic.

members.name: RetrievePieceFR
members.text: The system must retrieve a piece provided in the trans-elevador stock (T).

members.name: IdentifyPieceFR
members.text: The system must identify the type of the retrieved piece (P1 or P2).

members.name: StorePieceFR
members.text: The system must transport and store the piece in the arrival stock (SA) or departure shared stock (SPD) according to the mission parameter p.

members.name: DecideTargetRouteFR
members.text: The controller must logically decide the correct route to the target stock based on the piece color and mission parameter.

members.name: ReleasePieceFR
members.text: The manipulator must physically release the piece into the target stock.

members.name: PrioritizeSPEFR
members.text: The system must prioritize the collection of a piece present in the entry shared stock (SPE) to avoid blocking the other unit.

members.name: DetectSPEPresenceFR
members.text: The system must detect if there is a piece waiting in the entry shared stock (SPE).

members.name: ExecutePriorityLogicFR
members.text: The controller must override the nominal routing to grab the priority piece from the SPE.

members.name: NavigateAutonomouslyFR
members.text: The system must navigate autonomously using lines and direction indicators on the floor, stopping when an obstacle is encountered.

members.name: FollowLineFR
members.text: The drive system must follow the navigation lines and color pads on the floor to reach the destination.

members.name: HaltOnObstacleFR
members.text: The drive system must immediately halt movement when an obstacle is detected in the path.

members.name: ReturnToStandbyFR
members.text: The system must automatically return to its standby position (PA) when both the trans-elevador (T) and the entry shared stock (SPE) are empty.

members.name: SystemConstraintsNFR
members.text: The system must comply with the operational, performance, and safety constraints of the production environment.

members.name: MaintenanceNFR
members.text: The system must execute the mission without requiring any preventive or curative maintenance during operation.

members.name: SafetyZoneNFR
members.text: The system must not penetrate the restricted machine zones.

members.name: DetectZoneLimitNFR
members.text: The sensors must detect the physical boundaries of the restricted machine zones.

members.name: AvoidZoneNFR
members.text: The drive system must prevent or halt any movement that crosses into the restricted machine zones.

members.name: MissionTimeNFR
members.text: The system must complete the nominal mission within a maximum time of 4 minutes.

members.name: PriorityTimeNFR
members.text: A piece appearing in the priority stock (SPE) must be retrieved within a maximum delay of 2 minutes.

members.name: PriorityRoutingTimeNFR
members.text: The controller must process the SPE priority interrupt and calculate the new route.

members.name: PriorityTravelTimeNFR
members.text: The drive system must transit to the SPE location within the allocated time budget.

members.name: PriorityExtractionTimeNFR
members.text: The grabber must physically extract the priority piece within the allocated time budget.

members.name: AutonomyNFR
members.text: The system must operate autonomously without human intervention or remote control after the initial start.
